agents.name: Strategy Lead
agents.produces: Strategic framing, priorities, decision criteria and delegated strategy work.
agents.public_description: Owns strategic reasoning and coordinates strategy work.
agents.receives: Objectives, constraints, evidence summaries and portfolio context.

agents.name: Planning Agent
agents.produces: Sequenced tasks, owners, prerequisites, acceptance criteria and escalation points.
agents.public_description: Converts objectives into executable task sequences.
agents.receives: Approved objectives, constraints, dependencies and available capacity.

agents.name: Roadmap Agent
agents.produces: Milestones, dependency maps, critical paths and roadmap revisions.
agents.public_description: Builds milestones, dependencies and longer-term execution paths.
agents.receives: Strategic priorities, task plans, dependencies, risks and target dates.

agents.name: Decision Agent
agents.produces: Weighted comparison, assumptions, tradeoffs and decision-ready recommendation.
agents.public_description: Evaluates alternatives and produces decision-ready recommendations.
agents.receives: Decision question, options, criteria, evidence, uncertainty and constraints.

agents.name: Portfolio Agent
agents.produces: Portfolio ranking, sequencing recommendations, conflicts, deferrals and rebalancing triggers.
agents.public_description: Prioritizes competing initiatives against strategy, capacity, value and risk.
agents.receives: Candidate initiatives, strategic objectives, dependencies, capacity, value estimates and risk findings.

agents.name: Research Lead
agents.produces: Research plan, evidence standard, specialist assignments and synthesized findings.
agents.public_description: Directs research and determines what evidence is required.
agents.receives: Research questions, decision context, source constraints and evidence gaps.

agents.name: Evidence Agent
agents.produces: Source set, provenance, claim-to-evidence links, confidence and gaps.
agents.public_description: Finds and evaluates supporting evidence.
agents.receives: Research questions, source criteria, date bounds and known claims.

agents.name: Comparison Agent
agents.produces: Normalized comparison, differentiators, limitations and ranked findings.
agents.public_description: Performs structured alternative, competitor and option comparisons.
agents.receives: Alternatives, comparison criteria, evidence and uncertainty.

agents.name: Knowledge Agent
agents.produces: Structured knowledge, reusable summaries, links, conflicts and freshness markers.
agents.public_description: Organizes accumulated knowledge and makes it reusable.
agents.receives: Verified findings, definitions, decisions, provenance and update signals.

agents.name: Data Lead
agents.produces: Coordinated data architecture decisions, analytical plans and governed outputs.
agents.public_description: Coordinates data work and analytical outputs, including database model, caching, batch/stream and normalization tradeoffs.
agents.receives: Data requests, schemas, pipeline questions and architecture tradeoffs.

agents.name: Metrics Agent
agents.produces: Metric definitions, formulas, targets, ownership, cadence and guardrails.
agents.public_description: Defines KPIs, measurements and performance indicators.
agents.receives: Objectives, processes, data availability, baselines and decision needs.

agents.name: Analysis Agent
agents.produces: Descriptive results, diagnostic findings, uncertainty and reproducible analysis notes.
agents.public_description: Performs descriptive and diagnostic analysis.
agents.receives: Validated datasets, metric definitions, analytical question and assumptions.

agents.name: Forecast Agent
agents.produces: Forecasts, intervals, scenarios, backtests, limitations and monitoring triggers.
agents.public_description: Handles forecasting and forward-looking analytical work.
agents.receives: Time-indexed validated data, forecast horizon, drivers, constraints and loss criteria.

agents.name: Data Quality Agent
agents.produces: Completeness, consistency, validity, timeliness and reliability findings with remediation advice.
agents.public_description: Checks completeness, consistency, validity and reliability of data, including schema normalization tradeoffs.
agents.receives: Datasets, schemas, lineage, validation rules and intended analytical use.

agents.name: Engineering Lead
agents.produces: Technical plan, delegated engineering work, integration decisions and readiness evidence.
agents.public_description: Owns technical execution and coordinates engineering agents.
agents.receives: Approved requirements, architecture constraints, risks, telemetry and quality gates.

agents.name: Architecture Agent
agents.produces: Architecture recommendations, decision records, interfaces, boundaries and failure assumptions.
agents.public_description: Designs system architecture, interfaces and technical boundaries, including API, caching and consistency-versus-availability tradeoffs.
agents.receives: Requirements, system telemetry and interface, caching, consistency and CAP tradeoffs.

agents.name: Implementation Agent
agents.produces: Proposed code changes, migrations, implementation notes and test evidence.
agents.public_description: Converts approved designs into working implementation.
agents.receives: Approved design, acceptance criteria, repository context, constraints and test requirements.

agents.name: Test Agent
agents.produces: Test plan, results, defect reports, regression evidence and coverage gaps.
agents.public_description: Tests functionality and identifies defects and regressions.
agents.receives: Requirements, implementation artifacts, interfaces, fixtures and risk scenarios.

agents.name: Reliability Agent
agents.produces: Failure-mode analysis, resilience recommendations, recovery checks and stability risks.
agents.public_description: Evaluates operational resilience, failure modes and system stability, including caching and availability tradeoffs.
agents.receives: Architecture, telemetry, service objectives, dependency map and failure history.

agents.name: Economic Lead
agents.produces: Economic framing, delegated analyses, integrated commercial case and decision advice.
agents.public_description: Oversees economic analysis and commercial outcomes.
agents.receives: Commercial objective, constraints, demand evidence, cost data and resource context.

agents.name: Cost Agent
agents.produces: Cost model, unit economics, sensitivity analysis and major cost drivers.
agents.public_description: Analyzes costs, expenses and cost drivers.
agents.receives: Resource plan, price inputs, usage assumptions, time horizon and uncertainty.

agents.name: Value Agent
agents.produces: Value model, ROI scenarios, payback assessment and impact narrative.
agents.public_description: Evaluates value creation, ROI and impact.
agents.receives: Benefits, costs, risks, time horizon, baseline and strategic objectives.

agents.name: Resource Agent
agents.produces: Allocation options, capacity plan, bottlenecks and optimization recommendations.
agents.public_description: Optimizes resources, capacity and allocation.
agents.receives: Demand, capacity, constraints, service targets, skills and cost information.

agents.name: Commercial Agent
agents.produces: Market assessment, pricing options, revenue model, assumptions and commercial risks.
agents.public_description: Covers market, pricing, revenue and business models.
agents.receives: Customer problem, market evidence, competitive context, costs and constraints.

agents.name: Quality Lead
agents.produces: Assurance plan, delegated reviews, consolidated findings and gate recommendation.
agents.public_description: Leads quality governance, standards and assurance.
agents.receives: Requirements, outputs, evidence, policies, risk assessments and release criteria.

agents.name: Review Agent
agents.produces: Independent critique, defects, strengths, conflicts and requested corrections.
agents.public_description: Performs independent reviews and critical assessments.
agents.receives: Work product, requirements, evidence, assumptions and review rubric.

agents.name: Verification Agent
agents.produces: Pass/fail findings, evidence links, exceptions and unresolved verification gaps.
agents.public_description: Verifies work, evidence and compliance.
agents.receives: Claims, artifacts, acceptance criteria, policies, provenance and test evidence.

agents.name: Risk Agent
agents.produces: Risk register, likelihood-impact assessment, controls, owners and residual risk.
agents.public_description: Identifies risks and ensures mitigations are in place.
agents.receives: Plans, architecture, dependencies, assumptions, controls and operating context.

agents.name: Release Agent
agents.produces: Release readiness decision, blocking findings, approval request and rollback conditions.
agents.public_description: Final quality gate and release readiness control.
agents.receives: Approved change set, test and verification results, risk acceptance, rollback plan and release criteria.

leads.name: Strategy Lead
leads.public_description: Owns strategic reasoning and coordinates strategy work.

leads.name: Research Lead
leads.public_description: Directs research and determines what evidence is required.

leads.name: Data Lead
leads.public_description: Coordinates data work and analytical outputs, including database, caching, batch/stream and normalization tradeoffs.

leads.name: Engineering Lead
leads.public_description: Owns technical execution and coordinates engineering agents.

leads.name: Economic Lead
leads.public_description: Oversees economic analysis and commercial outcomes.

leads.name: Quality Lead
leads.public_description: Leads quality governance, standards and assurance.

numbering_policy: PRIME is the unnumbered orchestrator; the 29 specialists use contiguous identifiers a01-a29.

orchestrator.name: JARVIS PRIME
orchestrator.produces: Bounded task routing, synthesized decisions, recommendations, approval requests and audit events.
orchestrator.public_description: Receives the objective, governs execution, routes work and coordinates all specialist agents.
orchestrator.receives: Human objectives, governed system telemetry, evidence and lead outputs.
